create_nash_md_trainer: create a NashMDTrainer with a model, reference model, reward function, and NashMDConfig for RLHF training
build_geometric_mixture_wrapper: build a GeometricMixtureWrapper that samples from logits of a model and reference model geometric mixture
run_training_step: run the NashMDTrainer training step to compute loss from model and mixture completions with rewards
compute_nash_md_losses: compute Nash-MD losses from model logprobs, reference logprobs, and sigmoid probabilities
log_training_statistics: log NashMD training statistics including KL divergence, entropy, rewards, margins, and accuracies
